description: Test of card doors and objects with access lists (access model step 7): a requires-only fallback, card copies made in conversation and from a held keycard, a UID-only DESFire copy at two readers, and a card two NPCs share. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove the client sends every held card id to role-list and person-list rfid locks, shows the server's answer (opened, Access denied, Reader requires full authentication), and that card copies are recorded on the server with their source, including across a reload
